move.instructions: You are playing chess as black against white, and it is your move. Which of your legal moves in `position` is the strongest one to play? Checkmating the opponent's king wins the game, and a player who resigns loses it. The game is drawn by stalemate, by insufficient material, by agreement, when the same position occurs five times, or after 75 moves by each side with no capture and no pawn move. Either player may also claim a draw once a position has occurred three times, or after 50 moves by each side with no capture and no pawn move.

criteria.false: No: the position still has play in it, or you stand better.
criteria.true: Yes: you stand clearly worse, or neither side has any real winning chances left.

offer_draw.instructions: You are playing chess as black. Take a draw only when you no longer expect to win by playing on: you stand clearly worse, or the position is a dead draw with no winning chances left for either side. A level position that still has play in it is not a reason to draw — either side can still win it. Should you offer your opponent a draw now, while still playing your move?

resign.instructions: You are playing chess as black. Is the game in `position` lost for you beyond any doubt, so that you should resign?
